The structure of Cr₂Ni₄Si₆ (CrNi₂Si₃) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃mc (No. 143), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers with 9 geometric neighbors, Ni centers with 9 neighbors, and Si centers in two environments: 8 neighbors and 10 neighbors, the latter forming a 2D periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cr and Ni 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Ni and Si 10-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
